How to use urTimer
urTimer shows the time left as a shape that shrinks, drains or fills. You can read it from across the room, so it works for classrooms, meetings, workouts and focused work.
Pick a length
Tap a preset from 5 to 60 minutes, or choose Custom for any time up to 12 hours. On the Classic dial you can also drag around the face to set the minutes.
Choose a style
Pick one of 19 styles, from the Classic dial and the full Circle to Tide, Hourglass and Stars. Change the color, or set your own background color or photo.
Press Start
Pause whenever you need to. Reset brings back the full time. A soft chime plays when time is up, and your screen stays awake while the timer runs.
Line up tasks
Add tasks with their own lengths and press play to run one. Turn on Auto-start next to move through the list without touching anything.
Press Start and watch the time run out. The line under the timer shows when it ends.
Full screen hides everything except the timer, so it is easy to read on a projector or a TV.

Good to know
Full screen hides everything except the timer, which makes it easy to read on a classroom projector or a TV.
Share creates a link that opens with the same time, style and colors. Your settings and tasks stay in this browser.
